qc_recommended: >=0 integer; inspect segmentation/alignment if large discontinuities occur
notes: Channel-independent segmented ROI area represented as the number of pixels in the binary mask.

methodDesc: Binary ROI masks originate from the backlit RootCam segmentation and are reused by FC_analysis.py. Primary-root and lateral-root masks are transferred directly from segmentation outputs. Root-tip and node ROIs are implementation-defined mask regions used by the fluorescence pipeline. The peri-root ROI is the exclusive region obtained by dilating the full root mask and subtracting the original root mask; root_plus_peri is the corresponding inclusive dilated mask. Pixel count is therefore a channel-independent property of the ROI mask and is not expanded across fluorescence filters or excitation protocols.

methodDesc: A RootCam fluorescence image is acquired using a user-selected FluorCam protocol and emission filter. axis_definition: wavelength axis from exported nm columns; full raw axis approximately 349.9nm-899.1nm
methodDesc: VNIR2 hyperspectral cubes are acquired under 365 nm UV excitation in reflection geometry and corrected using matched dark-reference measurements. Invalid pixels are repaired, spectra are Savitzky-Golay smoothed, and spatial median filtering is applied before horizontal flipping and padding. RootCam masks are transferred to the cube using two-stage registration: a shoot-derived transform against a leaf reference near 670 nm, followed by root refinement against a root-enhanced reference near 410 nm. Final root and exclusive peri-root ROIs are used to export wavelength-resolved mean, sum and standard-deviation spectra.

qc_recommended: confirm x/y coordinates and wavelength columns are preserved; axis length should match exported nm columns in 349.9nm-899.1nm window; expect variable row count by ROI size (n_pixels)
notes: Per-pixel VNIR2 fluorescence spectra are matrix/tabular outputs with spatial coordinates. They are written as Parquet by default, with CSV available as an optional interchange format, and are not expanded into one registry variable per wavelength or pixel.
internal_codename_note: VNIR1 = white-light transmittance; VNIR2 = UV-induced fluorescence emission in reflection geometry.
axis_definition: matrix rows = ROI pixels with x/y coordinates; columns = wavelength bands over approximately 349.9nm-899.1nm
traitName: peri-root region fluorescence emission pixel spectra
methodDesc: After VNIR2 dark correction, invalid-pixel repair, spectral smoothing, spatial filtering and RootCam-mask registration, all pixels inside the aligned root or exclusive peri-root ROI are exported with their x/y coordinates and complete wavelength-resolved spectra. Parquet is the default storage format for this large matrix-like export; CSV is available optionally.

source_table_hint: Seeding.(xlsx|csv) raw Boxeed column: Seed Side
qc_recommended: value must be 0 or 1
notes: Acquisition-side indicator, not a biological plant trait.
methodDesc: The Boxeed raw seeding export contains one row per imaged seed side. Seed Side (0/1) distinguishes the two orthogonal views, while Length, SSE, AxesAngle, Width, Surface and PixelCount are emitted directly in the raw table. The vendor does not disclose the exact segmentation, ellipse-fit or calibration algorithms. Manuscript-level quantities such as L/S ratio, roundness, selection thresholds, or averages across the two sides are downstream derived values and are intentionally not separate canonical source variables in this registry.
methodRef: Boxeed raw Seeding table; Labdeers Boxeed 2.1 public documentation
